```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np, os
smi='CC1CC2(CC2)C1(C)C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=17, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
syms=[]; xyz=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
    syms.append(a.GetSymbol()); xyz.append((p.x,p.y,p.z))
atom=';'.join(f'{e} {x:.8f} {y:.8f} {z:.8f}' for e,(x,y,z) in zip(syms,xyz))
mol=gto.M(atom=atom,basis='6-31g*',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
for xc in ['b3lyp']:
    mf=dft.RKS(mol); mf.xc=xc; mf.conv_tol=1e-9; mf.max_cycle=100
    mf.kernel()
    e=np.array(mf.mo_energy)
    occ=np.array(mf.mo_occ)
    lumo=e[np.where(occ<1e-8)[0][0]]
    homo=e[np.where(occ>1e-8)[0][-1]]
    print('SMILES:', smi)
    print('Method: RKS',xc,'/ 6-31G*')
    print('SCF converged:', mf.converged)
    print('HOMO (Ha): %.10f'%homo)
    print('LUMO (Ha): %.10f'%lumo)
    print('Gap (Ha): %.10f'%(lumo-homo))
```
